description: Implementation of socket waiter using libevent for asynchronous socket event handling, including socket acceptance, wake-up mechanisms, and event management.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Private implementation of a socket waiter using libevent, managing socket events, wake-up signals, and callbacks.

methods.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing event base, wake-up mechanism, and socket pipes or sockets.

methods.name: ~SbSocketWaiterPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up events, sockets, and resources.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a socket to the waiter with specified interests and callback.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for socket events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter, optionally indicating a timeout.

methods.name: HandleSignal
methods.description: Handles socket signal events and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: HandleWakeUpRead
methods.description: Handles wake-up signals from the pipe or socket.

methods.name: AddWaitee
methods.description: Adds a waitee (socket event handler) to internal map.

methods.name: GetWaitee
methods.description: Retrieves a waitee for a given socket.

methods.name: RemoveWaitee
methods.description: Removes and returns a waitee for a given socket.
